this_title: Mothman's Lair: Creepy Abandoned House & Tnt Buildings (part Two) Point Pleasant
introduction: Dan Bell and Will Krupinsky continue their tour of creepy and abandoned places in Point Pleasant, WV, home of the folklore creature the Mothman. This second half of this two part film contains an exploration of a spooky long-deserted home as well as former TNT facility.
